cisco.scope: Advertised CSAF index: 2,888 links in 2017–2026 directories at review time.
limitations: Five sampled exact document URLs returned HTTP 403 to the anonymous local collector. Hosted document access has not been established.
The index is readable; that does not establish document availability or complete extraction.
Year-directory archive URLs are preserved; lower-case filenames cannot reconstruct mixed-case content API routes.
Provider metadata permits listing but disables raw mirroring; original vendor documents are not redistributed.
cisco.review_method: Automated assistant review of primary sources and bounded anonymous collector probes; not independent human certification.

arista.scope: Public Security Advisories HTML listing; advertised Next links; last advertised page included a June 2008 advisory.
limitations: Current RSS and CSAF RSS feeds are bounded windows; the HTML listing supplies historical enumeration.
Listing dates do not establish historical availability. Only reviewed advisory headings are queued.
Some historical document layouts may remain unsupported; failures stay visible.
arista.review_method: Automated assistant review of primary sources and bounded anonymous collector probes; not independent human certification.

paloalto.scope: Public unauthenticated advisory listing; no query filters. Landing page advertised 587 records at review time.
limitations: The advertised CSV export returned only the current 25-row page; it is not a full archive export.
The pure parser recognizes the exact published GET form page+1 control. Changed controls fail without executing source JavaScript.
Reviewed OSS HTML tables retain their per-CVE qualifications; other PAN-SA bulletins use an explicitly advertised CSAF representation.
paloalto.review_method: Automated assistant review of primary sources and bounded anonymous collector probes; not independent human certification.

fortinet.scope: Publisher default infrastructure product filter (19 product identifiers at review time); advertised Next links preserve it. Last advertised page included 2016 advisories.
limitations: This selection is not the full Fortinet portfolio: FortiProxy, FortiMail and other products are not independently selected, though a multi-product advisory may mention them.
Observed product selections are retained per page; any continuation that changes the filter is rejected.
The review tool received HTTP 403 while the direct anonymous collector retrieved these pages. Hosted access is checked separately during collection.
IR identifiers discover official canonical document routes; listing product text is not normalized as an impact assessment.
The sampled CSAF publication timestamps have no timezone. UTC is not inferred; unusable publisher dates are counted and excluded from the archive date range.
fortinet.review_method: Automated assistant review of primary sources and bounded anonymous collector probes; not independent human certification.
